exact_results.rh_criterion: RH iff Q_xi belongs to N_0
exact_results.conditional_index_bound: Q_xi in N_kappa implies at most kappa distinct xi-zero locations with Re(rho)>1/2

firewall: A multiplicity-m zero still gives a simple logarithmic-derivative pole; multiplicity is stored in the residue -m.
Therefore the generic N_kappa pole-count theorem is used only for distinct off-axis zero locations.
No claim that Q_xi belongs to N_kappa for finite kappa>0 is made.
RH iff N_0 is a reformulation, not a proof.

provenance.classical_criterion: RH iff Re[xi'/xi](s)>0 on Re(s)>1/2 is classical (Hinkkanen; highlighted by Lagarias 1999).
provenance.coordinate_rewrite: With s=1/2-i z, Im Q_xi(z)=Re[xi'/xi](s), so RH iff Q_xi in N_0 is the same classical criterion in Nevanlinna coordinates.
provenance.project_specific_layer: The project-specific result is the Cayley/Pontryagin crosswalk from localized Suzuki/de Branges negative-square data to this classical target.
